description: This file defines a Swift enum 'OpenClawCanvasA2UIJSONL' with methods for parsing, validating, decoding, and encoding JSON Lines messages related to a specific UI protocol version (v0.8). It includes nested struct 'ParsedItem' and methods for handling JSON data and validation rules for message types.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIJSONL

classes.name: ParsedItem

methods.description: Validates ParsedItems against allowed message types for protocol version 0.8.
